name: TIDE | Threat Intel to Detection PRs

parameters.jsCode:
// Build one Claude request per KEV entry asking for a Sigma rule draft.
const system = `You are a detection engineer on an internal Threat Intelligence and Detection Engineering team.
Write ONE Sigma rule (YAML) that detects likely exploitation or post-exploitation of the given vulnerability,
using telemetry an enterprise realistically has (EDR process/network/file events, web server or proxy logs, cloud audit logs).
Requirements:
- Valid Sigma: title, id (random UUIDv4), status: experimental, description, references (the CVE and its NVD URL),
  author: TIDE automation (AI draft), date (YYYY-MM-DD, today), tags (attack.* technique tags and cve.YYYY-NNNNN),
  logsource, detection, falsepositives, level.
- Prefer behavioural indicators (process lineage, suspicious child processes, anomalous requests) over brittle IOCs.
- Where exact field values are uncertain, use conservative logic and explain it in a YAML comment.
Respond with ONLY the raw YAML. No prose, no markdown fences.`;

return $input.all().map(item => ({ json: { ...item.json, claude_request: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 2000,
  system,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `CISA KEV entry:\n${JSON.stringify(item.json, null, 2)}` }],
}}}));

' + '**Vulnerability:** ' + $('Parse Sigma Rule').item.json.vuln_name + '
